# Research v2: why the page feels flat, and what to build instead

Date: 2026-10-03. Sources: Refero Styles (searched live in Osman's Refero Pro account), live sites in Chrome, YouTube videos read via Firecrawl, two local competitors.

## 1. Diagnosis of the current page (Osman's feedback, confirmed in a screenshot)

- **Pitch black, nothing to look at.** The hero is white text on `#0D0E13` with no image or motion. Every Refero agency style that "pulls you in" opens on a full-bleed photo or film, not on type alone.
- **Out-of-place colour.** The bright cyan LAVAALL screenshot and the template mocks' glows clash with the near-black canvas. The canvas has no warmth to tie them together.
- **No hook.** Nothing invites the visitor to *do* something in the first screen. The best AI-service sites let you try the product in the page.
- **Videos look like screen recordings.** They are small, framed, and use system fonts.

## 2. Refero styles reviewed (IDs are style records)

| Style | ID | What it teaches |
|---|---|---|
| **11x, Digital workers** | `850ee61c-4ecd-4558-9c0c-fab99721b34c` | Sells AI workers with **warm, cinematic full-bleed photography** and huge type, not dark tech UI. The AI worker is a named person ("Julian") you can **talk to live** on the page. Dark teal `#0b252a` bands instead of black, cream `#f5ece5` / clay `#e7d3bf` surfaces, white and black pill buttons, 16 to 32px radii, no shadows. |
| **Hardworkclub** | `1775bf6a-afdd-48b1-8435-b92ec585c674` | "Black-box theater": a full-bleed **film is the hero**, no overlay copy, one accent used only on one control. Dark works when the footage carries the colour. |

| **Limón** (restaurant) | `f1b6a7d6-1ecb-4f1c-95b0-e03323363999` | Hospitality done right: near-black olive, edge-to-edge food photos, **one loud lemon `#f7ea48` CTA** only on dark. |
| VALIENTE BRANDS | `f63bf016-5b53-4ddf-9f8c-da43f75a9e2b` | Warm clay canvas `#e7a196` with one signal red. Shows warmth can be bold. Too loud to lead, kept as a note. |

## 3. How this kind of service is sold (YouTube)

- **"The Only AI Automations Local Businesses Care About" (Serop, 2026):** owners do not buy "efficiency". They buy **more customers and less lost money**. Pitch the missed call or unanswered message as lost money, then show the fix.
- **"The $1M+ AI Automation Agency Landing Page Framework" (Wize Templates):** offer in big text, a CTA with a low-commitment line under it, a **video right below the CTA**, proof, services, a 4-step process, FAQ, booking, and a big closing CTA.
- Recurring titles ("Sell this restaurant automation", "AI receptionist", "Instagram DM agent") confirm that the **receptionist / DM reply** is what sells first to restaurants and hotels.

## 4. Local competitors

- **CYGEC IT Solutions (Monrovia):** "Today's Thought, Tomorrow's Solutions", a dated Drupal/Elementor site, client logos, quote form, no AI, no WhatsApp.
- **AdHang "Sierra Leone" page:** a template SEO page from a Nigerian firm (Nigerian WhatsApp number), no automation.
- **Gap:** nobody local shows modern design, motion, or AI you can try. The bar is low. A cinematic, warm site with a live demo would stand alone.

## 5. Proposed direction: "Golden hour"

**Primary reference: 11x.** Warm cinematic photography and film, oversized type, a named assistant you can try. **Borrow only:** Hardworkclub's full-bleed film as the opening (no clutter over it), and Limón's single loud CTA colour on dark.

Reference lock:
- **Preserve (from 11x):** full-bleed warm footage in the hero; huge display type in white over it; dark teal bands, not pure black; cream/clay light sections so the page breathes; pill buttons; a named assistant with a live try-it demo.
- **Borrow:** the hero film has only the headline and one CTA over it (Hardworkclub); the CTA uses one loud colour reserved for "Message us / Try it" (Limón's lemon, here a warm sun yellow, CTA only).
- **Reject:** pure `#000` everywhere, decorative glows and gradients, small framed screen recordings, cyan screenshots on dark, logo walls or testimonials we do not have.
- **Media:** (1) a 10 to 15s hero film of real West African business scenes at golden hour (Higgsfield image-to-video from our five stills, or new shots); (2) the automation videos re-made as **phone-in-hand** shots: a phone screen showing the WhatsApp reply composited over the restaurant/hotel footage, with self-hosted fonts; (3) the work shown as large 2-up frames, colour-graded to sit on teal.

Section order (YouTube framework, adapted to what is true for us):
1. Hero film + "More customers. Fewer missed messages." (draft) + CTA "Try the assistant" + low-commitment line.
2. **"Meet Ama"** (name TBD): a scripted WhatsApp-style chat you can tap through (restaurant / hotel / shop tabs). The agent drafts, the owner approves. Clearly labelled demo.
3. A 30s reel: what we build, shown full-bleed.
4. By business: restaurants, hotels, shops, marketers, each speaking about customers and money.
5. Real work (2-up, large).
6. Templates (current gallery, re-skinned to cream).
7. How it works, 4 steps.
8. FAQ (data costs, phones, WhatsApp, who approves posts).
9. Contact + WhatsApp.

## 6. Decision ledger

| Decision | Source | Role kept | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Warm full-bleed film hero | 11x, Hardworkclub | hero media only | Osman: "nothing draws you in"; every pull-in reference opens on footage |
| Teal and cream instead of black | 11x tokens `#0b252a`, `#f5ece5` | section surfaces | Fixes "pitch black" while staying premium |
| One loud CTA colour | Limón `#f7ea48` rule | CTA only, on dark only | One clear action per screen |
| Live "try the assistant" demo | 11x "Talk to Julian" | interactive proof | We have no testimonials; letting owners try it is stronger and honest |
| Customers and money copy | Serop video | messaging | Owners buy customers, not efficiency |
| Video under the CTA | Wize framework | sequencing | Proven agency funnel |
| No logos or testimonials | Brief rule | n/a | Replaced by the live demo and our own work |

## 7. Needs Osman's go-ahead

1. The "Golden hour" direction above (or ask for alternatives).
2. Higgsfield credits for the hero film and phone-in-hand shots (image-to-video, a few clips).
3. A name for the assistant.
